purpose: Measure architecture-controlled prediction, uncertainty, temporal causality, learned-only marginal caution, and authority-disabled integration for the FerrumOS and Physical JEPA world models without replacing a deployed artifact.
claim_boundary: All newly generated observations are software or shadow evidence unless an external execution manifest identifies physical hardware and an independent operator.
A local simulator, PyBullet DIRECT run, replayed sensor trace, or QEMU run is not independent third-party assessment or physical HIL.
Learned output may add caution or request confirmation. It may not grant permission, remove a deterministic block, execute an actuator command, or expand a capability.
The study is diagnostic and cannot promote or replace a deployed artifact. A separate frozen promotion protocol would be required after all runtime and authority gates pass.

ferrumos_base_dataset.availability: local reproduction input; public lineage is identified by DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21829193

shared_conditions.checkpoint_rule: lowest validation Gaussian negative log likelihood; every method completes the full fixed update budget

training_curriculum: episode-disjoint training partition of the frozen base dataset
training partition generated only from the frozen v3 incident source catalog
ferrumos.calibration_partition: episode-disjoint base validation plus v3 incident validation
ferrumos.final_partition: existing published episode-disjoint base test plus the already-opened v3.4 final catalog

physical.calibration_partition: base, incident-v2, and stress validation partitions

required_outputs: parameter count and fixed optimizer-update count
H=1, H=3, and H=5 normalized rollout error with paired episode bootstrap intervals
Brier score, ECE, and reliability bins
epistemic ensemble variance, predicted aleatoric variance, and an OOD distance score
paired architecture comparisons on identical samples
architecture_controlled_comparison.interpretation_rule: A difference is architecture-controlled only when training rows, curriculum, partitions, update budget, parameter-budget tolerance, and evaluation cases all pass verification. Point-estimate leadership without a paired interval excluding zero is descriptive only.

required_case_types: delayed resource exhaustion or delayed physical constraint violation
counterfactual pairs with the same initial state and different first actions
temporal_causality.pairing_rule: Counterfactual members share the initial state, exogenous schedule, and all random draws except the intervention action.
metrics: individual treatment-effect error on represented state dimensions
multi-action H=3 and H=5 rollout error
uncertainty under observation masking and exogenous shift

learned_contribution_benchmarks.selection_inputs: development generator and validation partitions only
learned_contribution_benchmarks.primary_measure: additional harmful outcomes avoided by the learned branch at a validation-matched false-positive or intervention rate

manifest_must_identify: absence of access to selected model predictions and final thresholds

required: canonical natural command sequences or recorded natural telemetry
p50, p95, p99, and maximum latency
concurrent request serialization and failure recovery
unseen workload and multi-agent contention slices
proof that no shadow decision reaches execution authority

hil_label_requirements: actuator output electrically or mechanically disabled

frozen_safety_invariants: rules_plus_learned equals the logical union of independently recorded rule and learned decisions
a deterministic block cannot be erased by any learned score or uncertainty value
missing, malformed, non-finite, OOD, or deadline-expired learned output fails to caution or deterministic fallback and never to permit
selection and evaluation outputs target research-only paths
protected deployed digests are checked before and after every executable stage
no promotion, replacement, adapter delivery, or physical actuator authority is available to this protocol
